measurement: Each row was compiled with the canonical Ninja-generated GC/1.3 command, followed by objdiff-cli diff. Scores and sizes are direct JSON output; duplicate controls are included. No variant source is retained.
primary_new_hypothesis: Reuse one widened int current local for the outer-loop conversion and the later three-call window cursor, rather than the separately assigned outer16 tried previously. This tests whether the shared phase value reproduces retail r29 without a clrlslwi.
primary_source_transformations: Change u16 outer to int outer and u16 current to int current.
Use (current = (u16)outer) < count as the outer condition.
Use current = (u16)first before the three window calls.
primary_result: Equal 420-byte size and 99.28571%, but 14 differing instructions rather than baseline 12. Other declaration orders regress.
other_new_hypotheses: Hoist table/end declarations while permuting the shared widened phase lifetime.
Use one scan index through the final window loop, or give the scans independent indices.
Separate a widened window base from a narrow iterator; this changes the instruction layout (416/424/440-byte variants), so reject.
Change narrow-variable scopes and initialization points to alter allocator interference.
Express truncations as masks and reconstruct explicit loop test/backedge control flow; neither improves the frontier.
